meaning_en: Clearly separate and different.
example_en: There are three distinct types of apples.
examples_extra: There are two quite distinct groups in class.
The two artists have quite distinct personal styles.

meaning_en: Having a quality that makes something recognizable.
example_en: The building has a very distinctive architectural style.
examples_extra: She has a wonderfully distinctive singing voice indeed.
The new building has a truly distinctive shape.

meaning_en: To recognize or point out a difference.
example_en: It's hard to distinguish between genuine and fake antiques.
examples_extra: Can you easily distinguish between the identical twins?
It is hard to distinguish fact from fiction.

meaning_en: To separate and go in different directions.
example_en: Their opinions began to diverge on key policy issues.
examples_extra: The two main roads diverge sharply right here.
Their political opinions diverged sharply over the years.

meaning_en: Tending to be different or develop in different directions.
example_en: The study revealed divergent views among the participants.
examples_extra: They hold quite divergent political views today.
The final test results were surprisingly divergent indeed.

meaning_en: Showing a great deal of variety; very different.
example_en: The city is known for its diverse cultural population.
examples_extra: The modern city has a richly diverse population.
We now offer many diverse evening courses.

meaning_en: To make or become more varied.
example_en: Companies should diversify their investments to reduce risk.
examples_extra: Local farmers will diversify into rural tourism.
The large company plans to diversify its product range.

meaning_en: Powered by electricity; or very exciting and thrilling.
example_en: The atmosphere at the concert was absolutely electric.
examples_extra: He proudly drives a new electric car now.
The stadium atmosphere was absolutely electric tonight.

meaning_en: A rich, vivid green color, like the gemstone.
example_en: Her eyes were a striking emerald green.
examples_extra: She wore an emerald ring on her finger.
The hills were a deep emerald green.

meaning_en: To consider one thing to be the same as another.
example_en: You shouldn't equate wealth with happiness.
examples_extra: Do not equate wealth with happiness.
He equates success with money.
note_fa: برابر دانستن؛ یکسان شمردن دو چیز.

meaning_en: To feel sad or unhappy.
example_en: She often feels blue during the long, dark winter months.
examples_extra: I feel blue on rainy days.
He feels blue on rainy days.

meaning_en: Producing bright light by absorbing and re-emitting radiation.
example_en: The office was lit by harsh fluorescent lights.
examples_extra: The office has fluorescent lights.
She wore a fluorescent jacket.

meaning_en: Having reddish-orange hair.
example_en: She has beautiful ginger hair and freckles.
examples_extra: He has bright ginger hair.
The ginger cat sat on the wall.

meaning_en: Adopt environmentally friendly practices.
example_en: Our company is trying to go green by reducing waste.
examples_extra: The company decided to go green.
Many cities are going green.

meaning_en: A political party focused on environmental protection.
example_en: The Green Party advocates for sustainable policies.
examples_extra: She votes for the Green Party.
The Green Party won three seats.

meaning_en: Environmentally responsible travel to natural areas.
example_en: Many resorts now promote green tourism initiatives.
examples_extra: Green tourism protects nature and wildlife.
Costa Rica promotes green tourism.

meaning_en: Extremely jealous of someone else's possessions or success.
example_en: I was green with envy when I saw her new car.
examples_extra: She was green with envy.
He went green with envy at my car.

meaning_en: A situation unclear or difficult to define.
example_en: The legality of that action is a grey area.
examples_extra: The law is a grey area here.
It's a grey area, legally speaking.

meaning_en: Brain cells, often used humorously for intelligence.
example_en: I need to use my grey cells to solve this puzzle.
examples_extra: Come on, use your grey cells!
It takes some grey cells to solve.

meaning_en: Brain tissue, often used to refer to intelligence.
example_en: This problem requires some serious grey matter.
examples_extra: Use your grey matter to solve it.
The job needs plenty of grey matter.
note_fa: اصطلاح: مغز/هوش؛ use your grey matter یعنی «مغزت را به کار بگیر».

meaning_en: Colours that are too bright or clashing.
example_en: The artist used harsh colours to convey anger.
examples_extra: The room has harsh colours.
She strongly dislikes harsh colours.

meaning_en: So similar that it is impossible to tell apart.
example_en: The twins were almost indistinguishable from each other.
examples_extra: The twins are almost indistinguishable.
His house was indistinguishable from the others.

meaning_en: Able to be exchanged or used in place of another.
example_en: The parts are interchangeable, making repairs much easier.
examples_extra: The two parts are interchangeable.
These words are almost interchangeable.

meaning_en: A greenish color, like the precious stone.
example_en: She wore a beautiful jade necklace.
examples_extra: She wore a jade necklace.
The vase is jade green.

meaning_en: A very deep, shiny black color.
example_en: She had long, flowing jet black hair.
examples_extra: She has long jet black hair.
The cat's fur was jet black.

meaning_en: A small, green citrus fruit, similar to a lemon.
example_en: I added a slice of lime to my drink.
examples_extra: Add a slice of lime to the drink.
The walls were painted lime green.

meaning_en: To appear sick or inexperienced.
meaning_fa: رنگ‌پریده به نظر رسیدن، بی‌تجربه بودن
example_en: After the long flight, he looked a bit green.
examples_extra: You look a bit green; are you feeling sick?
He looked quite green after the roller coaster.

meaning_en: A pale purple color.
example_en: She painted her bedroom walls a soft mauve.
examples_extra: She wore an elegant mauve silk scarf today.
The small bedroom walls were painted pale mauve.

meaning_en: Using only one color or shades of one color.
example_en: The old photograph was a beautiful monochrome image.
examples_extra: That old photo is in pure monochrome.
She wore a chic monochrome outfit tonight.

meaning_en: Quiet, shy, and unassuming; also dull brown hair.
example_en: Her mousy brown hair blended into the background.
examples_extra: She has dull, mousy brown hair today.
The shy, mousy girl spoke very softly indeed.

meaning_en: A very dark blue color.
example_en: He wore a smart navy suit to the interview.
examples_extra: She wore a smart navy suit today.
Deep navy blue is truly elegant tonight.

meaning_en: Pale and soft in color.
example_en: The room was decorated in lovely pastel shades of blue.
examples_extra: She wore soft pastel colours today.
The walls are painted pastel blue.

meaning_en: Extremely dark, with no light at all.
example_en: The cave was pitch black, requiring a flashlight.
examples_extra: The room was pitch black.
It was pitch black outside.

meaning_en: Any of three colors (red, yellow, blue) from which others are mixed.
example_en: Red, yellow, and blue are the primary colours.
examples_extra: Yellow is a primary colour.
Red, yellow and blue are primary colours.

meaning_en: (Of a face) flushed with anger or embarrassment.
example_en: His face went red with fury.
examples_extra: His face went red with anger.
She turned red with embarrassment.
note_fa: در این معنا: سرخ شدن چهره (از خشم/خجالت).

meaning_en: A warning of extreme danger.
example_en: The city was on red alert after the terror threat.
examples_extra: The city is on red alert.
Hospitals are on red alert.

meaning_en: A warning sign of a potential problem or danger.
example_en: His inconsistent story raised a red flag for the detective.
examples_extra: His anger was a red flag.
Lies are a red flag in interviews.

meaning_en: Special, luxurious treatment given to an important guest.
example_en: The visiting dignitary received full red-carpet treatment.
examples_extra: They gave her the red-carpet treatment.
All guests got royal red-carpet treatment.
note_fa: پذیرایی ویژه و مجلل از مهمان مهم.

meaning_en: A color that is a mix of red and brown.
example_en: The old wooden table had a beautiful reddish brown hue.
examples_extra: She has reddish brown hair.
The soil is reddish brown.

meaning_en: A day that is memorable because of a special event.
meaning_fa: روز مهم و به یاد ماندنی
example_en: Our graduation was a real red-letter day for the whole family.
examples_extra: It was a red-letter day for us.
Graduation was a red-letter day.

meaning_en: deep red in color, like the gemstone
example_en: She wore a beautiful ruby necklace to the gala.
examples_extra: She wore a dress of deep ruby red.
The sunset turned the sky a ruby colour.

meaning_en: A deep blue color, like the precious gemstone.
example_en: Her sapphire eyes sparkled in the sunlight.
examples_extra: She wore a necklace with a large sapphire stone.
The lake shone a deep sapphire blue in the sun.

meaning_en: A brilliant red color, often with an orange tinge.
example_en: She wore a beautiful scarlet dress to the party.
examples_extra: Her face turned scarlet with embarrassment at once.
The flag was a brilliant scarlet against the grey sky.

meaning_en: To become extremely angry suddenly.
meaning_fa: از کوره در رفتن، عصبانی شدن
example_en: When he insulted her, she just saw red.
examples_extra: He sees red whenever he's insulted.
Don't make her see red.

meaning_en: A very bright, intense shade of pink.
example_en: She wore a dress in shocking pink.
examples_extra: She wore shocking pink today.
The walls are shocking pink.

meaning_en: Bright, intense, and vivid colors.
example_en: The artist used strong colours in her abstract painting.
examples_extra: She loves strong colours like red.
The room was painted in strong colours.

meaning_en: Equivalent to something, especially something bad.
example_en: His silence was tantamount to an admission of guilt.
examples_extra: His silence was tantamount to agreement.
The cut is tantamount to a ban.

meaning_en: A slight amount of a color or feeling.
example_en: The sky had a beautiful orange tinge at sunset.
examples_extra: Her hair has a tinge of red.
There was a tinge of sadness in his voice.

meaning_en: Become pale and sick-looking, often from nausea.
example_en: The child started to turn green on the bumpy ride.
examples_extra: The leaves turn green in spring.
He turned green with envy.
note_fa: turn green with envy یعنی «از حسادت سبز شدن».

meaning_en: A greenish-blue color.
example_en: The ocean water was a stunning turquoise.
examples_extra: She wore a turquoise dress.
The sea was a clear turquoise.
note_fa: یعنی «فیروزه‌ای»؛ برای چشم به کار نمی‌رود.

meaning_en: Extremely pale, usually due to fear, shock, or illness.
example_en: She went white as a sheet when she heard the news.
examples_extra: She went white as a sheet.
He turned white as a sheet.

meaning_en: Extremely white; pure and innocent.
meaning_fa: مثل برف سفید، پاک و معصوم
example_en: The freshly fallen snow was white as snow.
examples_extra: The fields were white as snow.
Her hair is white as snow.

meaning_en: A person who performs professional, managerial, or administrative work.
example_en: Many white-collar workers are now working remotely.
examples_extra: He is a white-collar worker.
White-collar workers fill city offices.

meaning_en: Causing intense fear or excitement.
example_en: It was a white-knuckle ride on the roller coaster.
examples_extra: It was a white-knuckle ride.
The film has white-knuckle scenes.

meaning_en: Morally pure and beyond reproach; extremely virtuous.
meaning_fa: پاک‌تر از پاک، بی‌عیب و نقص
example_en: He tried to appear whiter than white, but his past was murky.
examples_extra: He claims to be whiter than white.
No politician is whiter than white.

meaning_en: forming adjectives meaning 'full of' or 'like'.
example_en: The weather was quite cloudy and windy today.
examples_extra: The -y suffix forms adjectives.
Words with -y sound informal.
note_fa: در کتاب نیست؛ پسوند صفت‌ساز: rainy، sandy.
